prompt: You are onboarding an AI agent into your team's CI/CD pipeline. Which of the following is the BEST first step?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Identify the specific SDLC steps the agent will perform and define clear success criteria

options.text: Configure the agent with full repository write access immediately
Identify the specific SDLC steps the agent will perform and define clear success criteria
Allow the agent to reason freely across all pipeline stages without constraints
Deploy the agent to production before testing in staging
